diagnosis: The view dismisses a generic moderation flag based solely on flag_id. It fails to check if request.user is a designated community moderator for the space or tenant that owns the underlying flagged entity (flag.content_object), enabling regular authenticated members to prematurely dismiss abuse reports.
exploit_request:
POST /api/moderation/flags/519/dismiss/ HTTP/1.1
Host: community.platform.io
Authorization: Bearer <member_token>
